name: Massachusetts Backyard 24
blurb: Twenty-four birds you can find from a yard, a feeder, or a walk around the block.
_comment: Editorial. Which birds belong in a 'backyard' set is a judgement about habitat and recognisability that no dataset makes for you, so this is a hand-written list of scientific names and build_deck.py attaches the numbers. Order here does not matter -- the builder ranks by reportingIndex and cuts by tierShape.
_design: The eight easiest are year-round residents gettable in January. The middle introduces winter visitors (Dark-eyed Junco, White-throated Sparrow) so the set teaches that some birds only exist here in the cold. The hard end is spring-and-summer only. A January player physically cannot finish this deck, and has a reason to still be playing in May.
_omissions: Cooper's Hawk belongs in a backyard set and is deliberately absent: eBird moved it to genus Astur, GBIF's backbone marks Astur as DOUBTFUL, and the records drop out entirely. Left out rather than faked. See README.
